mapper.insert: insert into njupt_physim.tasks(teacher, clazz_id, exp_id, start_date, end_date, total_count) VALUES (#{teacher}, #{clazzId}, #{expId}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{totalCount})
mapper.select: select c.id as id, stu_id, score, u.name as stuName from njupt_physim.completions c left join njupt_physim.users u on c.stu_id=u.id where task_id=#{taskId} and clazz_id=#{clazzId}
